title: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
content:
Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY) is a safe motherhood scheme under the National Health Mission. It provides cash assistance to pregnant women for institutional delivery.

Cash Assistance

  • Low performing states: ₹1,400 (rural), ₹1,000 (urban)
  • High performing states: ₹700 (rural), ₹600 (urban)

Additional Benefits

  • Free delivery at government health facilities
  • Free transport to health facility
  • Free diet during stay
eligibility: Pregnant women belonging to BPL/SC/ST households. Age 19+ years. For institutional delivery only.
benefits: ₹600-1,400 cash assistance for institutional delivery, free delivery, free transport, free diet.

title: Stand-Up India Scheme
content:
Stand-Up India Scheme was launched in 2016 to facilitate bank loans between ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises.

Loan Details

  • Loan amount: ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore
  • Composite loan covering 85% of project cost
  • Tenor: 7 years with moratorium period of 18 months
  • Interest rate: Base rate + 3% + Tenor premium
eligibility: SC/ST women entrepreneurs, or women entrepreneurs. Must be 18+ years. Enterprise must be greenfield (new venture). Must not be in default to any bank.
benefits: Loan ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore, 85% project cost financing, 18 months moratorium, handholding support.

title: Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Yojana (PMRY)
content: PM Rozgar Yojana provides employment opportunities to educated unemployed youth by facilitating self-employment through industry, business, service, and farm sector ventures.
eligibility: Educated unemployed youth aged 18-35 years (SC/ST: 18-40 years). Minimum 8th pass. Family income below ₹40,000 per annum.
benefits: Subsidized loans for self-employment ventures, skill training, marketing support.

title: National Pension Scheme (NPS)
content:
National Pension System (NPS) is a voluntary defined contribution pension system regulated by PFRDA. It provides market-linked returns and tax benefits.

Key Features

  • Market-linked returns (equity + debt)
  • Tax benefits up to ₹2 lakh under Section 80C and 80CCD
  • Low fund management charges
  • Portable across jobs and locations
  • Partial withdrawal allowed (up to 25%)
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18-65 years. Both employed and self-employed can join.
benefits: Market-linked returns, tax benefits up to ₹2 lakh, low charges, portability, partial withdrawal facility.

title: PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
content:
Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY) provides free food grains to beneficiaries under the National Food Security Act. The scheme was launched during COVID-19 and has been extended.

Benefits

  • 5 kg food grains per person per month FREE (rice, wheat, or millets)
  • Over 80 crore beneficiaries covered
  • Additional 5 kg under NFSA (now free)
  • Total 10 kg per person per month (5 kg NFSA + 5 kg PMGKAY)
eligibility: All beneficiaries under National Food Security Act (NFSA) - Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Households (PHH).
benefits: 5 kg free food grains per person per month, total 10 kg including NFSA allocation.

title: PM Ujjwala Yojana
content:
Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana provides free LPG connections to women from BPL households. The scheme was launched in 2016 and aims to replace unhealthy cooking fuels.

Benefits Under Ujjwala 2.0

  • Free LPG connection (deposit, regulator, cylinder, hose, gas stove)
  • First refill cylinder free
  • Security deposit waived
  • Over 9.5 crore LPG connections delivered
eligibility: Women from BPL households (SECC list), women from SC/ST, Antyodaya Anna Yojana families, forest dwellers, primitive tribal groups, most backward classes.
benefits: Free LPG connection with equipment, first refill free, clean cooking fuel.

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
content:
Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) is a government-backed savings scheme for girl children. It offers one of the highest interest rates among small savings schemes.

Key Features

  • Interest rate: 8.2% per annum (compounded annually)
  • Minimum deposit: ₹250 per year
  • Maximum deposit: ₹1,50,000 per year
  • Tax benefits under Section 80C (up to ₹1.5 lakh)
  • Maturity amount completely tax-free
  • Tenure: 21 years from account opening
eligibility: Girl child below 10 years of age. Maximum 2 accounts per family. One account per girl child.
benefits: 8.2% interest rate (highest among small savings), full tax exemption, partial withdrawal at 18 for education.

title: PM Matru Vandana Yojana
content:
Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) provides cash incentive of ₹5,000 to pregnant and lactating mothers for first living child. It compensates for wage loss during pregnancy and after childbirth.

Benefits

  • ₹5,000 in 3 installments
  • Cash transfer directly to bank/post office account
  • First installment: ₹1,000 after registration
  • Second installment: ₹2,000 after 6 months of pregnancy
  • Third installment: ₹2,000 after child birth and immunization
eligibility: All pregnant and lactating mothers for first living child (excluding girls born under BBBP). Must be 19+ years. Must have registered at health facility.
benefits: ₹5,000 cash incentive in 3 installments, direct bank transfer.

title: Digital India Programme
content:
Digital India is a flagship programme of the Government of India to transform India into a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy. Launched on 1st July 2015.

Three Core Components

  • Digital Infrastructure: Broadband highways, universal access to mobile connectivity, public internet access programme
  • Governance & Services: e-Governance, e-Kranti, information for all
  • Digital Empowerment: Digital literacy, digital resources, industry digitization

Key Schemes Under Digital India

  • BharatNet (broadband to villages)
  • DigiLocker (digital document storage)
  • e-Sign (digital signatures)
  • UMANG (unified government services app)
eligibility: All Indian citizens. Various sub-schemes have specific eligibility.
benefits: Digital infrastructure access, e-governance services, digital literacy, DigiLocker, UMANG app.

title: Swachh Bharat Mission
content:
Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM) was launched on 2nd October 2014 to achieve universal sanitation coverage. It has two components: Urban and Rural.

SBM - Gramin (Rural)

  • Individual Household Latrines (IHHLs)
  • Community and Public Sanitation Facilities
  • Solid and Liquid Waste Management
  • Over 11 crore toilets built

SBM - Urban

  • Toilet construction and renovation
  • Door-to-door waste collection
  • Waste processing and disposal
  • ODF (Open Defecation Free) certification
eligibility: Rural: BPL households, SC/ST, women-headed households, persons with disabilities. Urban: All urban households.
benefits: ₹12,000 for toilet construction (rural), ₹15,000 (urban), community toilet support, solid waste management.

title: PM-KUSUM Solar Pump Scheme
content:
PM-KUSUM (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan) scheme provides solar energy solutions to farmers. It has three components.

Components

  • Component A: Standalone solar powered agriculture pumps (up to 7.5 HP)
  • Component B: Solarization of existing agriculture pumps
  • Component C: Installation of grid-connected solar power plants (500 kW to 2 MW)

Subsidy

  • Central subsidy: 30-60% depending on category
  • State subsidy: additional 30%
  • Farmer pays only 10-40%
eligibility: All farmers (individual or group), FPOs, cooperatives. Must have agriculture land and existing/bore well.
benefits: Solar pump at 10-40% cost, additional income from selling surplus power, reduced electricity bills.

title: Pradhan Mantri Vay Vandana Yojana (PMVVY)
content:
Pradhan Mantri Vay Vandana Yojana is a pension scheme exclusively for senior citizens aged 60 years and above. It provides guaranteed pension with life insurance cover.

Key Features

  • Assured pension: 8% per annum
  • Investment limit: ₹15 lakh
  • Pension payment: monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, or annually
  • Loan facility: up to 75% of deposit after 3 years
  • Maturity benefit: full deposit refund
  • Life insurance: proportionate to pension amount
eligibility: Senior citizens aged 60 years and above. Maximum investment ₹15 lakh.
benefits: 8% assured pension, ₹15 lakh max investment, loan facility, life insurance cover.

title: Kanya Sumangala Yojana
content:

  • Benefits linked to birth registration and school enrolment/continuation
  • Implemented through the Women Welfare Department, Government of UP

How it Works

Assistance is released in instalments tied to milestones such as birth, immunisation, and admission to Class 1, 5, 8, 9, 10, 11 and graduation, as per the official portal.
eligibility: Girl child born on or after 01 April 2019 in a Uttar Pradesh family with no more than two living children, meeting the eligibility criteria published on the official portal.
benefits: Rs. 25,000 total, paid in 6 installments: Rs. 5,000 (birth) + Rs. 2,000 (vaccination) + Rs. 3,000 (Class 1) + Rs. 3,000 (Class 6) + Rs. 5,000 (Class 9) + Rs. 7,000 (graduation). Income limit: Rs. 3 lakh. Max 2 girls per family.

Eligible children are enrolled and provided assistance / incentives as per the official portal criteria.
eligibility: Children of registered labourers / workers of Uttar Pradesh within the age and documentation criteria prescribed on the official portal.
benefits: As per official portal: education support / stipend and incentives for school enrolment and retention.
meta_title: Bal Shramik Vidya Yojana UP - Education for Workers...

title: Saat Nishchay Yojana (Bihar)
content:
Saat Nishchay (the "Seven Resolves") is a flagship governance programme of the Bihar government aimed at inclusive development of every gram panchayat and ward. It guarantees basic public services to citizens.

The 7 Resolves

  • Ghar Tak Pakki Sadak - pucca road to every home
  • Har Ghar Nal Ka Jal - piped drinking water to every home
  • Sauchalay Nirman - household toilets
  • Nishchay Matritva - safe motherhood and child health
  • Kushal Yuva - skill training for youth
  • Student Credit Card - education loan support
  • Greenery and clean environment in every settlement

Objective

To deliver universal basic infrastructure and services so that no household in Bihar is left without roads, water, toilets, electricity and a clean environment.
eligibility: Citizens of Bihar at the gram panchayat / ward level; benefits are delivered through respective government departments and local bodies as per scheme-specific criteria.
benefits: Universal public services: all-weather roads, piped drinking water, household toilets, electricity, safe motherhood support, youth skill training and a clean green environment.
meta_title: Saat Nishchay Yojana Bihar - 7 Resolves of Bihar Government

title: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme (BSCC)
content:
Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme (BSCC) is a flagship education scheme of the Bihar government to help students pursue higher and professional education without financial hardship. The state government acts as a guarantor for the education loan.

Key Features

  • Education loan of up to Rs. 4 lakh
  • Covers professional courses, computer certificate courses, CA, CFA, ICWA and recognised higher studies
  • Loan disbursed through the Bihar Education Finance Corporation
  • Repayment begins after course completion with a grace period

Objective

To raise the state Gross Enrollment Ratio (GER) for higher education by removing the cost barrier for meritorious students.
eligibility: Bihar resident students who have passed 12th standard and secured admission in a recognised institution for higher / professional studies. Age and other criteria are as per the official portal.
benefits: Education loan of up to Rs. 4 lakh with the state government as guarantor, covering tuition and course-related expenses for higher / professional studies.
meta_title: Bihar Student Credit Card Yojana (BSCC) - Rs. 4 Lakh...

title: Jeevika (Bihar Rural Livelihoods Promotion Society - BRLPS)
title_hi: जीविका (बिहार ग्रामीण आजीविका संवर्धन समिति - BRLPS)
content:
Jeevika is the Bihar Rural Livelihoods Promotion Society (BRLPS), the implementing agency under the Bihar Rural Livelihoods Project. It is among the largest rural livelihoods initiatives in the world, organising rural women into self-help groups (SHGs) for access to credit, livelihoods and entrepreneurship.

Key Features

  • Formation and strengthening of women self-help groups (SHGs) and their federations
  • Access to bank credit and livelihood diversification
  • Support for farm and non-farm enterprises
  • Convergence with state schemes for women and rural development
eligibility: Rural women of Bihar who join or form a self-help group (SHG) under the Jeevika programme. Membership and group formation norms are as per BRLPS.
benefits: Institutional support, access to group savings and bank credit, livelihood training and entrepreneurship support for rural women.
meta_title: Jeevika Bihar (BRLPS) - Rural Livelihoods & Women SHG...

title: Bihar Agriculture Road Map
content:
The Bihar Agriculture Road Map is the state agriculture policy framework that guides farmer support, input subsidy, irrigation expansion and crop diversification to increase agricultural productivity and farmer income across Bihar.

Key Features

  • Farmer support and agricultural input subsidy
  • Irrigation development and water-use efficiency
  • Promotion of better seeds, technology and crop diversification
  • Convergence with central schemes such as PM-KISAN where applicable

Exact subsidy amounts and eligibility are as per the official agriculture department notification.
eligibility: Farmers of Bihar cultivating notified crops and meeting the land / registration criteria prescribed by the Agriculture Department on the official portal.
benefits: Farmer support, input subsidy and irrigation development to improve productivity and income, as per official rates.
meta_title: Bihar Agriculture Road Map - Farmer Support & Subsidy

title: Mukhyamantri Nishchay Swayam Sahayata Bhatta (Bihar)
content:
Mukhyamantri Nishchay Swayam Sahayata Bhatta Yojana (MNSSBY) is a Bihar government scheme to support educated unemployed youth during their job search and skill development.

Key Features

  • Monthly unemployment allowance to educated unemployed youth
  • Provided for a defined period while the beneficiary seeks employment
  • Linked with skill training and registration on the state portal

Objective

To provide financial support to unemployed youth so they are not forced into distress while seeking employment.
eligibility: Bihar residents who are educated unemployed youth meeting the qualification and age criteria notified on the official portal. Registration and verification are completed as per department norms.
benefits: Rs. 1,000 per month (corrected — the Rs. 1,500 upper range is incorrect per official sources). Provided for max 2 years. Requires Kushal Yuva Program (KYP) training enrollment.
meta_title: Mukhyamantri Swayam Sahayata Bhatta Bihar - Unemployment...

title: Bihar Old Age Pension Scheme
content:
The Bihar Old Age Pension Scheme is a social security programme of the Bihar government providing a monthly pension to eligible senior citizens so they have a steady income in old age.

Key Features

  • Monthly pension to eligible senior citizens
  • Implemented through the Social Welfare Department, Bihar
  • Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the beneficiary bank account

The pension amount and eligibility criteria are as notified by the department on the official portal.
eligibility: Resident senior citizens of Bihar meeting the age and income / family-status conditions prescribed by the Social Welfare Department. Beneficiaries already receiving another state / central pension are generally not eligible.
benefits: Rs. 1,100 per month (Mukhyamantri Vridhjan Pension Yojana, increased from Rs. 400 in June 2025). Separate central IGNOAP pension of Rs. 200/month for 60+ BPL also available. Credited via DBT.
meta_title: Bihar Old Age Pension Scheme - Monthly Pension for...

title: Mukhyamantri Awas Yojana Bihar
content:
Mukhyamantri Awas Yojana Bihar is the state housing initiative to provide pucca houses and financial assistance to eligible poor and weaker-section families in Bihar.

Key Features

  • Pucca house / financial assistance to eligible families
  • Convergent with PM Awas Yojana where applicable
  • Ownership preferential in the name of the woman of the household

Assistance amount and eligibility are as per the official notification.
eligibility: Poor / weaker-section families of Bihar as per the housing department income and deprivation norms on the official portal.
benefits: Pucca house / financial assistance to eligible families, released in instalments as per official norms.
meta_title: Mukhyamantri Awas Yojana Bihar - Housing for Poor Families

title: Mukhyamantri Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana (Bihar)
content:
Mukhyamantri Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana is a Bihar government health-assistance scheme to provide free or subsidised treatment to eligible residents at government hospitals.

Key Features

  • Free / assisted treatment at government hospitals
  • Support for specified medical conditions as per the scheme
  • Managed through the state health department framework

Covered treatments and assistance amounts are as per the official notification.
eligibility: Residents of Bihar with annual family income up to Rs. 4 lakh (increased from Rs. 2.5 lakh in June 2026). Covers Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 5,00,000 for serious/untreatable diseases at govt or CGHS-approved hospitals.
benefits: Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 5,00,000 for serious/untreatable diseases. Income limit: Rs. 4 lakh/year (raised from Rs. 2.5 lakh in June 2026). Treatment at government or CGHS-approved hospitals.
meta_title: Mukhyamantri Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana Bihar - Free Treatment

title: Balika Protsahan Yojana (Bihar)
content:
Balika Protsahan Yojana is a Bihar government scheme to encourage the education of the girl child by providing a financial incentive on continuation of studies.

Key Features

  • Financial incentive to girls for education
  • Aimed at reducing dropout among girls
  • Promotes continuation of education up to higher classes

Exact incentive amounts and eligibility are as per the official notification on the state portal.
eligibility: Girl students of Bihar who meet the class / attendance criteria notified by the Education Department on the official portal.
benefits: Two tiers: (1) Matric pass: Rs. 10,000 (1st division) or Rs. 8,000 (2nd division). (2) Intermediate pass: Rs. 25,000. Both under Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana. Unmarried Bihar girls who passed from BSEB eligible. DBT to Aadhaar-linked bank account.
meta_title: Balika Protsahan Yojana Bihar - Girl Education Incentive

title: Bihar Kanya Vivah Yojana
content:
Bihar Kanya Vivah Yojana is a state scheme to support the marriage of daughters from poor and weaker-section families by providing a marriage grant / assistance.

Key Features

  • Financial grant / assistance for the marriage of an eligible girl
  • Aimed at reducing the financial burden of marriage on poor families
  • Implemented through the Social Welfare / Women Welfare Department, Bihar

The grant amount and eligibility are as per the official notification.
eligibility: Daughters of poor / weaker-section families of Bihar within the income and documentation criteria prescribed on the official portal.
benefits: Marriage grant of Rs. 5,000 (basic) + Rs. 2,000 if marriage registered (total Rs. 7,000) for BPL daughters. NOTE: Some 2026 sources suggest possible increase to Rs. 10,000 — needs manual verification against official portal before updating.
meta_title: Bihar Kanya Vivah Yojana - Marriage Grant for Poor Families

title: Jeevika Sakhi Mandal (Women SHG Bank Linkage, Bihar)
title_hi: जीविका सखी मंडल (महिला SHG बैंक लिंकेज, बिहार)
content:
Jeevika Sakhi Mandal is the women self-help group (SHG) bank-linkage component of the Jeevika mission in Bihar. It connects women SHGs to the formal banking system for savings, credit and financial inclusion.

Key Features

  • Bank linkage of women SHGs for savings and credit
  • Group and member-level loans for livelihoods
  • Financial literacy and inclusion of rural women
  • Convergence with Jeevika / BRLPS institutions
eligibility: Rural women of Bihar who are members of a Jeevika self-help group (SHG / Sakhi Mandal) as per BRLPS norms.
benefits: Access to bank credit, group savings and financial inclusion support for rural women SHGs, as per official norms.
meta_title: Jeevika Sakhi Mandal Bihar - Women SHG Bank Linkage

title: Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Jan Arogya Yojana
title_hi: महात्मा ज्योतिबा फुले जन आरोग्य योजना
content: Cover of Rs. 1.5 lakh per family per year (base); Rs. 2.5 lakh for senior citizens and critical illnesses; Rs. 5 lakh when integrated with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
eligibility: Families holding a yellow or orange ration card in Maharashtra and registered farmer families as per the state eligibility list. Beneficiaries are identified through the official portal / district administration.
benefits: Cashless health cover: Rs. 1.5 lakh per family per year (base). Rs. 2.5 lakh for renal transplant and specified critical illnesses. Rs. 5 lakh per family per year when integrated with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY. Covers 1,356 procedures across 34 specialties.
meta_title: Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Jan Arogya Yojana Maharashtra -...

title: MahaDBT Post-Matric Scholarship
content:
MahaDBT (Maharashtra Direct Benefit Transfer) is the unified scholarship and benefit portal of the Government of Maharashtra. The Post-Matric Scholarship component supports students from SC, ST, OBC, SBC, VJNT, Minority and (income-based) open categories who are pursuing education after matriculation.

Key Features

  • Single-window online application for multiple state scholarship schemes
  • Coverage of tuition fee and maintenance allowance as per category and course norms
  • Direct Benefit Transfer of sanctioned amount to the student bank account
  • Renewal and fresh applications handled on the same portal

Objective

To promote higher education among backward and economically weaker sections by reducing the financial burden of tuition and living costs.
eligibility: Students of Maharashtra belonging to SC/ST/OBC/SBC/VJNT/Minority categories and income-eligible open-category students, studying in a recognised post-matriculation course, with family income within the notified limits for the respective scheme.
benefits: Tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance (admission/fee/other allowances) as per the category- and course-specific rates notified by the state government, paid via DBT.
meta_title: MahaDBT Post-Matric Scholarship Maharashtra - Apply Online

title: Mukhyamantri Annapurna Yojana (Maharashtra)
content:
Mukhyamantri Annapurna Yojana is a Maharashtra state scheme launched in 2024 providing free LPG cylinders to women beneficiaries.

Key Features

  • 3 free 14.2 kg LPG cylinders per year
  • For women with PM Ujjwala or Majhi Ladki Bahin connections
  • Implemented by the Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Protection Department, Maharashtra

Note

This is different from the central government Annapurna Scheme (NFSA) which provides 10 kg free food grains to destitute senior citizens aged 65+. The Maharashtra scheme focuses on LPG fuel support for women.
eligibility: Women of Maharashtra with active PM Ujjwala or Majhi Ladki Bahin LPG connections, meeting the eligibility criteria on the state portal.
benefits: 3 free 14.2 kg LPG cylinders per year.
meta_title: Mukhyamantri Annapurna Yojana Maharashtra - Free LPG...

title: Shiv Bhojan Thali
content:
Shiv Bhojan Thali is a Maharashtra government initiative to provide a hot, nutritious, subsidised meal to citizens from economically weaker sections at a nominal price. The scheme is operated through empanelled canteens / centres across the state.

Key Features

  • Nutritious Thali at a highly subsidised rate (Rs. 10 nominal charge)
  • Available through designated Shiv Bhojan centres in urban and rural areas
  • Aims to make at least one balanced meal affordable for the poor

Objective

To fight hunger and malnutrition by guaranteeing an affordable cooked meal to every needy citizen.
eligibility: Any citizen from an economically weaker / poor section in Maharashtra can avail the subsidised Thali at a designated Shiv Bhojan centre; no strict income bar is applied at the point of service.
benefits: A hot, nutritious meal (Thali) at a nominal price of Rs. 10, subsidised by the state government.
meta_title: Shiv Bhojan Thali Maharashtra - Nutritious Meal at Rs. 10

title: Mahatma Phule Karj Mafi (Farm Loan Waiver)
title_hi: महात्मा फुले कर्ज माफी योजना (कृषि ऋण माफी)
content:
Mahatma Phule Karj Mafi Yojana is the Maharashtra government farm-loan waiver scheme intended to relieve distress among small and marginal farmers by waiving eligible outstanding agricultural loans.

Key Features

  • Waiver of eligible short-term agricultural loans for qualifying farmers
  • Relief delivered through participating banks / cooperative credit institutions
  • Benefit amount and eligibility capped as per the official notification

Objective

To reduce the indebtedness of small and marginal farmers and support agricultural revival.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers of Maharashtra with eligible outstanding agricultural loans, meeting the landholding, loan-type and other criteria specified in the official waiver notification. Exact waiver ceiling is as per official portal.
benefits: Waiver of eligible agricultural loan amount up to the limit notified by the state government (as per official portal).
meta_title: Mahatma Phule Karj Mafi Yojana Maharashtra - Farm Loan...

title: Mukhyamantri Gram Sadak Yojana
content:
Mukhyamantri Gram Sadak Yojana (Chief Minister's Rural Road Scheme) is a Maharashtra state programme to provide all-weather pucca road connectivity to rural villages and habitations that lack it.

Key Features

  • Construction / upgradation of all-weather pucca roads to eligible habitations
  • Civic connectivity to markets, schools, health centres and block headquarters
  • Implemented through the state Rural Development / Public Works machinery

Objective

To improve last-mile rural connectivity and integrate villages with the economic mainstream.
eligibility: Rural habitations / villages in Maharashtra identified by the department as lacking all-weather road connectivity, prioritised by population and accessibility criteria as per the notified guidelines.
benefits: All-weather pucca road connectivity to the beneficiary village / habitation, built and maintained as per scheme standards.
meta_title: Mukhyamantri Gram Sadak Yojana Maharashtra - Rural Roads

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Maharashtra)
content:
Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) is implemented in Maharashtra as a central-state joint housing mission. Maharashtra implements both PMAY-Gramin (rural) and PMAY-Urban components.

Key Features

  • PMAY-Gramin: Rs. 1.20 lakh (plain) / Rs. 1.30 lakh (hilly/tribal) central assistance for house construction
  • PMAY-Urban 2.0: Credit-linked subsidy and beneficiary-led construction support
  • 60:40 central:state funding ratio
  • Implemented through Maharashtra Rural Development Dept and Urban Development Dept

Note

This is a central government scheme (PMAY) implemented in Maharashtra, not a standalone state scheme.
eligibility: Homeless / houseless and kutcha-house households in Maharashtra meeting the rural or urban poverty and residency criteria notified by the Housing / Rural Development department.
benefits: Central assistance of Rs. 1.20-1.30 lakh for rural house construction (PMAY-G); credit-linked subsidy and housing support for urban families (PMAY-U 2.0, 2024-2029).
meta_title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana Maharashtra - Housing for Poor

title: Majhi Kanya Bhagyashree Yojana
content:
Majhi Kanya Bhagyashree Yojana is a Maharashtra government scheme for the welfare of the girl child. It provides conditional incentives / benefits to encourage the education and well-being of girl children and to promote the girl-child sex ratio.

Key Features

  • Conditional benefit / incentive for eligible girl children in the family
  • Encourages education and continued schooling of the girl child
  • Promotes awareness against female foeticide

Objective

To secure the future of the girl child through financial support linked to education and upbringing.
eligibility: Girl children of Maharashtra families meeting the notified criteria (family size / income and girl-child conditions). Exact benefit amount and conditions are as per the official notification on the state portal.
benefits: Conditional financial benefit / incentive for the eligible girl child, paid as per the official scheme norms (as per official portal).
meta_title: Majhi Kanya Bhagyashree Yojana Maharashtra - Girl Child...

title: Maharashtra Employment Guarantee (MGNREGA Maharashtra)
content:
The Maharashtra Employment Guarantee scheme is the state implementation of the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA), providing a legal guarantee of 100 days of unskilled wage employment per financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer for such work.

Key Features

  • Legal guarantee of 100 days of wage employment per household per year
  • Wages paid to the bank / post-office account of the worker
  • Unemployment allowance if work is not provided within the stipulated period
  • One-third of the work force reserved for women

Objective

To enhance livelihood security in rural Maharashtra through guaranteed wage employment and durable asset creation.
eligibility: Any adult member of a rural household in Maharashtra who volunteers for unskilled manual work. Household registers with the Gram Panchayat to obtain a job card.
benefits: Up to 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per household per financial year, with wages paid as per the notified state wage rate.

title: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana
content:
Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana is a Maharashtra social-security scheme providing a monthly pension to destitute persons who have no means of subsistence and are not covered by any other pension scheme.

Key Features

  • Monthly pension to destitute, disabled, widows, elderly and transgender persons
  • Benefit for those without any other source of support
  • Direct Benefit Transfer to the beneficiary account

Objective

To provide a basic social-security net to the most vulnerable and unsupported sections of society.
eligibility: Destitute persons of Maharashtra who are disabled, widows, elderly, or transgender and who have no sustainable means of income and are not availing any other state / central pension, subject to the notified age and income criteria.
benefits: Rs. 1,500 per month financial assistance, credited directly to the beneficiary bank account. Covers destitute aged 18-65, widows, orphans, disabled, seriously ill (TB, cancer, AIDS, leprosy), abandoned/divorced women, transgender, devadasis, unmarried women over 35. Annual family income up to Rs. 21,000.
meta_title: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana Maharashtra -...

title: Sambal Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
content:
Sambal Yojana (Mukhyamantri Jan Kalyan) is a comprehensive social security scheme of the Madhya Pradesh government for unorganised workers, providing multiple benefits under one umbrella.

Key Benefits

  • Free 200 units of electricity per month
  • Accident death/disability insurance: Rs. 2-4 lakh
  • Maternity assistance: Rs. 16,000 (4 installments of Rs. 4,000)
  • Funeral assistance: Rs. 5,000
  • Free education for children of beneficiaries

Objective

To provide a comprehensive social security net to unorganised and informal-sector workers of Madhya Pradesh.
eligibility: BPL and eligible poor families of Madhya Pradesh meeting the income and residence criteria prescribed on the official portal.
benefits: Multi-benefit package for unorganised workers: (1) Free 200 units electricity per month, (2) Accident death/disability insurance Rs. 2-4 lakh, (3) Maternity assistance Rs. 16,000 (4 installments of Rs. 4,000), (4) Funeral assistance Rs. 5,000, (5) Free education for children.
meta_title: Sambal Yojana MP - Electricity Bill Relief for BPL Families

title: MP Krishak Samriddhi Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
content:
Mukhyamantri Krishak Samriddhi Yojana (MMKSY) is a Madhya Pradesh state scheme providing incentive payments above the Minimum Support Price (MSP) to registered farmers who sell eligible produce at government procurement centres.

Key Features

  • Per-quintal MSP incentive payments to farmers
  • For wheat, paddy, and other notified crops sold at procurement centres
  • Distinct from Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana (which provides direct income support of Rs. 6,000/year)
  • Implemented by Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development Department, MP

Objective

To incentivise farmers to sell produce at government procurement centres and ensure they receive remunerative prices above MSP.
eligibility: Farmers of Madhya Pradesh cultivating notified crops and meeting the land / registration criteria prescribed by the Agriculture Department on the official portal.
benefits: Per-quintal MSP incentive payments for eligible produce sold at government procurement centres. Amount varies by crop and procurement price.
meta_title: MP Krishak Samriddhi Yojana - Farmer Input Support

title: Gaon Ki Beti / Pratibha Kiran Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
title_hi: गांव की बेटी / प्रतिभा किरण योजना (मध्य प्रदेश)
content:
Gaon Ki Beti / Pratibha Kiran Yojana is a Madhya Pradesh government scheme to encourage the education of the girl child by providing a financial incentive for continuation of studies.

Key Features

  • Financial incentive to girls for education
  • Aimed at reducing dropout among girls
  • Promotes continuation of education up to higher classes

Exact incentive amounts and eligibility are as per the official notification on the state portal.
eligibility: Girl students of Madhya Pradesh who meet the class / residence / merit criteria notified by the Education Department on the official portal.
benefits: Gaon Ki Beti (rural girls): Rs. 500/month for 10 months = Rs. 5,000/year for general courses; Rs. 750/month = Rs. 7,500/year for engineering/medical. Pratibha Kiran (urban BPL girls): same amounts. Eligibility: 60%+ in 12th, enrolled in graduation, family income <=Rs. 2 lakh.
meta_title: Gaon Ki Beti / Pratibha Kiran Yojana MP - Girl Education...

title: Mukhyamantri Yuva Udyami Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
content:
Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarozgar Yojana is a Madhya Pradesh government scheme promoting self-employment among the youth by providing financial assistance and training support to set up enterprises.

Key Features

  • Financial / subsidy support for youth to start self-employment ventures
  • Training and handholding for enterprise setup
  • Aimed at reducing youth unemployment in the state

Exact subsidy amounts and eligibility are as per the official notification.
eligibility: Youth of Madhya Pradesh meeting the age, education, residence and enterprise criteria notified on the official portal.
benefits: Loan from Rs. 10 lakh to Rs. 2 crore for industry/service projects. Margin money: 15% of project cost (max Rs. 12 lakh general), 20% (max Rs. 18 lakh BPL). Interest subsidy: 5% per annum (6% for women) for up to 7 years.
meta_title: Mukhyamantri Yuva Udyami Yojana MP - Youth Enterprise Loan

title: MP e-District Services (Madhya Pradesh)
content:
MP e-District Services is the Madhya Pradesh government online platform for delivering citizen-centric services such as income certificates, caste certificates, residence certificates, and other government services.

Key Features

  • Online application and tracking for certificates and services
  • Reduces the need to visit government offices physically
  • Transparent, time-bound service delivery
eligibility: Residents of Madhya Pradesh requiring government certificates / services as listed on the official e-District portal.
benefits: Convenient online access to certificates and citizen services with tracked, time-bound delivery.
meta_title: MP e-District Services - Online Certificates & Citizen...

title: Madhya Pradesh Old Age / Widow Pension Scheme
title_hi: मध्य प्रदेश वृद्धावस्था / विधवा पेंशन योजना
content:
The Madhya Pradesh Old Age / Widow / Disabled Pension Scheme is a social security programme of the state government providing a monthly pension to eligible senior citizens, widows and persons with disabilities.

Key Features

  • Monthly pension to eligible senior citizens, widows and disabled persons
  • Implemented through the Social Justice / Social Welfare Department
  • Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the beneficiary bank account

The pension amount and eligibility criteria are as notified by the department on the official portal.
eligibility: Resident senior citizens, widows and persons with disabilities of Madhya Pradesh meeting the age and income / family-status conditions prescribed by the department. Beneficiaries already receiving another state / central pension are generally not eligible.
benefits: Rs. 600 per month for ages 60-79; Rs. 800 per month for age 80+ (Old Age Pension). Same rates apply for Widow Pension (Kalyani, ages 18-79) and Disability Pension (Divyang, 40%+ disability, ages 6+). Payments quarterly via DBT. Over 80 lakh beneficiaries.
meta_title: Madhya Pradesh Old Age / Widow Pension Scheme

title: Khadya Sathi
content:
Khadya Sathi is the food security programme of the Government of West Bengal aimed at ensuring that no one in the state goes to bed hungry. It provides subsidised food grains to ration card holders.

Key Features

  • Rice / wheat at ₹2 per kg to eligible ration card holders
  • Coverage of the majority of the state population under NFSA and state top-up
  • Distribution through Fair Price Shops (FPS)
  • Convergence with Aadhaar for beneficiary authentication

Objective

To achieve near-universal food security in West Bengal by providing affordable food grains to every eligible household.
eligibility: Ration card holders of West Bengal — priority and non-priority households under the National Food Security Act and state-specific categories as notified.
benefits: Subsidised food grains (rice / wheat) at ₹2 per kg per eligible beneficiary, distributed through Fair Price Shops.
meta_title: Khadya Sathi West Bengal - Rice & Wheat at ₹2/kg

title: Duare Sarkar
content:
Duare Sarkar (Government at the Doorstep) is a citizen outreach campaign of the Government of West Bengal that sets up camps at the gram panchayat / municipal ward level to deliver government services and scheme benefits directly to citizens.

Key Features

  • On-the-spot enrolment and application for multiple state schemes
  • Issuance / correction of caste, income, domicile and other certificates
  • Enrolment under Swasthya Sathi, Khadya Sathi and social security pensions
  • Camp-based service with department officials present at the venue

Objective

To take government services to the doorstep of citizens and improve last-mile delivery and awareness of welfare schemes.
eligibility: All residents of West Bengal can avail services at Duare Sarkar camps as per the specific scheme criteria for each service offered.
benefits: Convenient doorstep access to government schemes and certificates — health card enrolment, ration card services, pensions, caste / income / domicile certificates and more.
meta_title: Duare Sarkar West Bengal - Doorstep Government Services

title: Yuvashree
content:
Yuvashree is a West Bengal government scheme providing a monthly unemployment allowance to educated unemployed youth who are registered with the state employment bank, to support them while they seek suitable employment.

Key Features

  • Monthly allowance of ₹1,500 to eligible unemployed youth
  • For educated youth registered with the West Bengal employment bank
  • Direct Benefit Transfer to the beneficiary bank account

Objective

To provide financial support to educated unemployed youth and encourage them to register, train and seek employment.
eligibility: Educated unemployed youth of West Bengal registered with the state employment bank, meeting the educational qualification and age criteria notified on the official portal.
benefits: Monthly unemployment allowance of ₹1,500 transferred directly to the beneficiary bank account for the notified period.

title: Rupashree Prakalpa
content:
Rupashree Prakalpa is a West Bengal government scheme providing a one-time marriage grant to eligible poor families for the marriage of their daughters, to reduce the financial burden of marriage.

Key Features

  • One-time financial assistance of ₹25,000 per eligible girl at the time of marriage
  • Targeted at girls from economically weaker families
  • Direct Benefit Transfer to the beneficiary bank account

Objective

To provide financial support to poor families for the marriage of their daughters and discourage child marriage.
eligibility: Daughters of West Bengal families meeting the income and age criteria (generally 18 years and above at marriage) notified by the Women & Child Development / Social Welfare Department.
benefits: A one-time grant of ₹25,000 to the eligible family at the time of the daughter’s marriage, credited directly to the bank account.

title: West Bengal Student Credit Card
content:
The West Bengal Student Credit Card (WBSCC) scheme provides education loans of up to ₹10 lakh to students of the state for pursuing higher and professional education, with repayment beginning after course completion.

Key Features

  • Education loan of up to ₹10 lakh
  • Covers tuition, course and related educational expenses
  • Moratorium during the study period and flexible repayment tenure
  • Interest subvention / relaxations as per scheme norms

Objective

To remove the financial barrier to higher education for students of West Bengal and raise the state’s gross enrolment ratio.
eligibility: Resident students of West Bengal admitted to recognised higher / professional courses, meeting the academic and age criteria notified on the official portal. Parent / guardian as co-applicant generally required.
benefits: Education loan of up to ₹10 lakh with study-period moratorium and flexible repayment, covering higher / professional education costs.

title: Jai Bangla Pension Scheme (West Bengal)
content:
The West Bengal social security pension covers old age pension, widow pension and disability pension, providing a monthly pension to vulnerable sections so they have a steady income in old age or distress.

Key Features

  • Monthly pension to eligible senior citizens, widows and persons with disabilities
  • Implemented through the Department of Social Welfare
  • Direct Benefit Transfer to the beneficiary bank account

The pension amount and eligibility criteria are as notified by the department on the official portal.
eligibility: Residents of West Bengal meeting the age, widowhood / disability and income criteria prescribed by the Social Welfare Department. Beneficiaries already receiving another central / state pension may be excluded as per norms.
benefits: Rs. 1,000 per month for all categories: Old Age (60+), Widow (18+), and Disability (40%+). Previously Rs. 600-750/month; merged into unified Jai Bangla Pension from April 2020. Family income <=Rs. 1,000/month.

title: Sikshashree
content:
Sikshashree is a West Bengal government stipend scheme for students belonging to minority communities, aimed at reducing dropout and encouraging continuation of schooling.

Key Features

  • Stipend to eligible minority students (classes I to VIII and as notified)
  • Encourages retention of minority students in school
  • Direct Benefit Transfer to the beneficiary / guardian account

Exact stipend amount and eligibility are as per the official notification on the state portal.
eligibility: Students of West Bengal belonging to notified minority communities, meeting the class and income criteria prescribed by the Minority Affairs / Education Department on the official portal.
benefits: Rs. 800 per year for SC/ST day-scholars studying in Class V to VIII in government/government-aided schools. Annual family income must not exceed Rs. 2.5 lakh.
